name: inf-pursuit-open
note: PO 10-09 "Zombies loose track ... running very fast but past me. Then walking around, although in my direct near." One runner chases the courier who runs a zigzag across open asphalt (45 degree cuts every ~8 m). Look for: it closes in from behind, lunges at her and stays on her after every lunge (never ahead of her, never wandering off while she is near).
